description: Covers product search and prices at US stores by name, model, barcode or product_id. Appliance categories cover efficiency in the US, Australia and New Zealand. Prices exclude tax. Links may be paid. Divux does not check out.

budget_usd.description: Pre-tax budget in USD. Compare each exact, available offer against it without filtering the results.

category.description: Appliance type for efficiency ratings only.

compact.description: Appliances: compact, mini or countertop fridges and dishwashers instead of full-size

condition.description: Used includes open-box and refurbished. Default new.

country.description: US for store prices. US, AU or NZ for appliance ratings.

detail.description: Show up to 8 offers instead of 3.

energy_star.description: Appliance efficiency lookup; requires an appliance category.

in_stock_only.description: Legacy filter. Search only products with an in-stock offer.

include_out_of_stock.description: Include unavailable offers in the price comparison.

max_price.description: Maximum offer price in USD, including listed shipping.

model.description: Model number for an appliance rating.

most_efficient_only.description: Limit appliance results to the Most Efficient list.

product_id.description: Divux product ID for a price comparison.

query.description: Product name, model, barcode or brand plus product type.

state.description: Appliances: two-letter US state for the yearly running cost at that state's home electricity price

name: find_product
title: Shopper: products, prices, stock
